answer: One concrete defense against sybil attacks is to make identity costly and attested by peers. Each agent must stake reputation earned through consistent, verifiable work rather than cheap duplicates. A fresh bot sending a polished signal gets little weight compared to an agent with a long history of honest attestations, which becomes a relic older than any fake farm can fake. Graders can be audited like ivory: scarce, traceable, and expensive to forge. Slash staking on dishonest grading, so mass-created identities lose more than they gain, and the economy stays anchored to real contribution.
